verdict.rationale: Homebrew documents a public, unauthenticated JSON data API at formulae.brew.sh with per-package and analytics endpoints, curl examples and an example response schema. That API only reads package metadata; it cannot drive installs or other operations, which are done through the documented CLI rather than an API. Probes also found no OpenAPI spec or llms.txt. Missing for 10: an API that can perform actions (install, upgrade, manage) rather than read-only metadata, a formal API description (OpenAPI), versioned endpoints, independent corroboration of agent use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
